cases.purpose: Positive short write to an actual owned PTY recipient: deliver first3 of8 body bytes before returning3, compare remainder retry and complete bytes/status with native independent write-all control.
cases.oracle: Independent guarded Python os.write loop under the exact same unprivileged seccomp notification profile. First write to exact remembered child-owned recipient tty is delivered as abc through the real kernel tty before return3. Subsequent calls continue through the actual kernel. Native setup proves returned3/5, remainder buffer def CRLF, complete abcdef CRLF, actual PTY bytes and preserved modes. No LD_PRELOAD/static-link assumption, regular-file substitute, fake-positive-without-side-effect, root recipient or host behavior.
cases.comparison: Exact recipient.raw and result.json against native control; capture syscall PID/FD/tty/buffer/count/reply/delivered-prefix, raw receiver output and child stderr/status/modes/time. BASHWALL_NOBANNER=1 isolates body partial handling. Candidate refusal/nonzero/incomplete output remains FAIL, not normalized. Banner/EOF and util-linux user/utmp parity are not inferred from this body case.
